text: The two label sources disagree on 3.1 percent of the held-out rows.
The baseline reaches a held-out AUROC of 0.812, with a standard deviation of 0.004 over three seeds.
Pairwise interaction terms raise the held-out AUROC to 0.861. That is more than ten baseline standard deviations above the baseline.
Doubling the model depth without interaction terms leaves the held-out AUROC at 0.815, within one standard deviation of the baseline.
